summary: Frontend-only focused test of the new WeatherPill on Explore. All acceptance criteria met: Open-Meteo API called with Gaziantep coords (37.066, 37.3833), returned 200, pill rendered as '27°' with icon in top-right beside city-picker-button, no overlap with CITYQUEST kicker (kicker.right=97px, weather-pill.x=180px — 83px gap), city-picker-button still shows 'Gaziantep', POI cards render (25), tapping POI navigates to /poi/{id}, category chips present (10) and tappable. Silent-fail path verified via code review (try/catch + null-return guards).
critical_code_review_comments: WeatherPill implementation is clean: guards against null coords, silent try/catch, cleanup of setInterval on unmount, proper testID='weather-pill', accessibilityLabel present, uses StyleSheet.create, all text wrapped in <Text>.
CityHeader.topRight uses gap: spacing.sm to separate the two pills and layout is position:absolute in top row — no overlap detected with CITYQUEST kicker at 390px width.

Note (pre-existing, not from this change): React Native web console shows deprecation warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — WeatherPill uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Consider migrating to boxShadow in a future cleanup pass, but this is a warning only and does not affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WeatherPill live at Explore header, testID='weather-pill'. Open-Meteo public API, no key. Falls silently (returns null) on any failure. Coord source: city.lat/city.lng from CityHeader props.
